lessons.title: Your first blocks program
lessons.goal: Stop between 95 and 105 cm from the start
lessons.intro: No typing needed: snap blocks together to tell Dowee what to do. Every block becomes real Arduino code that you can see under the blocks.

lessons.title: Blink the LED
lessons.goal: Blink the LED 10 times
lessons.intro: Every Arduino has a small LED on pin 13. Turning it on and off is the "hello world" of robotics.

lessons.title: Drive exactly 1 metre
lessons.goal: Stop between 95 and 105 cm from the start
lessons.intro: Motors are controlled through a motor driver. analogWrite sets the speed (0–255) and two digitalWrite pins set the direction.

lessons.title: Turn 90 degrees
lessons.goal: Turn between 85° and 95° and stop
lessons.intro: Spinning one wheel forward and the other backward turns the robot on the spot.

lessons.title: See what the sensors see
lessons.goal: Print 20 lines of sensor values
lessons.intro: Line sensors shine infrared light at the floor. White reflects a lot (low number), black reflects little (high number).

lessons.title: Follow the line with 2 sensors
lessons.goal: Complete one full lap
lessons.intro: The simplest line follower: if the line is on the left, turn left. If it is on the right, turn right. Otherwise go straight.

lessons.title: PID 1: Where is the line?
lessons.goal: Complete one lap of the Oval
lessons.intro: A PID follower needs one number: how far the line is from the middle of Dowee. That number is called the error. You will work it out from all five sensors with a weighted average.

lessons.title: PID 2: P, steer smoothly
lessons.goal: Complete one lap of the Oval
lessons.intro: Step 1 steered in jumps: hard left, straight or hard right. The P part steers by how much: a little off means a little turn, far off means a big turn. turn = Kp * error.

lessons.title: PID 3: D, calm the wiggle
lessons.goal: Lap the Oval in under 18 seconds
lessons.intro:
With P alone Dowee overshoots: it turns towards the line, crosses it and has to turn back. The D part looks at how fast the error is changing and brakes the turn early, like easing off the steering wheel before you reach the middle of the lane.

What about I? The I part adds up the error over time. It fixes a robot that always drives a little to one side. Line followers rarely need it, so most racers only use P and D.

lessons.title: PID 4: Calibrate and race
lessons.goal: Lap the Snake track in under 15 seconds
lessons.intro: You can write P and D now. Real sensors all read a bit differently, so a racing follower first calibrates: it sweeps over the line and learns the darkest and brightest value of each sensor. Then it is time to tune for speed.

lessons.title: Bluetooth RC driver
lessons.goal: Finish one lap of the race track
lessons.intro: A phone app sends letters over Bluetooth: F for forward, L for left, S for stop. The robot reads them with Serial.read().

lessons.title: Ultrasonic eyes
lessons.goal: Reach the green goal zone
lessons.intro: An ultrasonic sensor sends a "ping" and times the echo. Sound travels 0.034 cm per microsecond, there and back.

lessons.title: Stay inside the ring
lessons.goal: Drive for 20 seconds without falling off
lessons.intro: A sumo robot that drives off the ring loses. The ring is black with a white edge, so line sensors can see the edge.

lessons.title: Win a sumo match
lessons.goal: Push the Hunter out of the ring
lessons.intro: Now add an opponent. Find it with the ultrasonic sensor, charge, and stay inside the ring yourself.

lessons.title: Score two goals
lessons.goal: Score 2 goals
lessons.intro: Robot soccer: push the ball into the goal on the right. Your Dowee is the yellow one.

lessons.title: Bug: Dowee goes backwards
lessons.goal: Drive forward at least 50 cm and stop
lessons.intro: This program should drive Dowee forward and stop. Instead it drives backwards! One small thing is the wrong way round.

lessons.title: Bug: Dowee only turns
lessons.goal: Drive forward at least 50 cm and stop
lessons.intro: Dowee should drive straight, but it only turns in a curve. One motor is not getting its direction signal. Read the messages under the code!

lessons.title: Bug: it won't upload
lessons.goal: Drive forward at least 50 cm and stop
lessons.intro: Press Upload & run: the program doesn't even start. Read the red error message. It tells you the line and what is missing.

lessons.title: Bug: turns the wrong way
lessons.goal: Complete one full lap
lessons.intro: This line follower turns away from the line as soon as it sees it. The left and right turns are mixed up.

lessons.title: Bug: one = or two?
lessons.goal: Complete one full lap
lessons.intro: Dowee keeps going round in circles. In C, = and == mean very different things. Find the wrong one.

lessons.title: Bug: the sleepy follower
lessons.goal: Complete one full lap
lessons.intro: This follower has the right idea, but it misses the turns. It only looks at the line every now and then.

lessons.title: Bug: black or white?
lessons.goal: Complete one full lap
lessons.intro: This follower uses analogRead. Black gives a big number and white a small one, but the program checks it the wrong way round.

lessons.title: Bug: forward is broken
lessons.goal: Drive forward at least 1 metre
lessons.intro: Every key works except forward. Look carefully at the letter the program waits for.

lessons.title: Bug: scared of nothing
lessons.goal: Reach the green goal zone
lessons.intro: This obstacle avoider turns all the time, even with nothing in front of it, and never gets anywhere.

lessons.title: Bug: afraid of the ring
lessons.goal: Push the Statue out of the ring
lessons.intro: This sumo robot backs away all the time, even in the middle of the black ring. Its edge check is upside down.
